clips.title: The story
paras: At Auberdine, the Empty Cleansing Bowl carries moonwell water against the Blackwood corruption. Mixed with food samples, the water makes a meal that briefly breaks the satyrs’ demonic sway over the furbolgs.

Thundris Windweaver gives the Empty Cleansing Bowl to adventurers in Auberdine to carry sacred water from the local moonwell. The night elves have learned that satyrs use enchanted talismans to drive the northern Blackwood furbolgs into demonic madness. Dip the bowl into the moonwell, then mix the water with nuts, grains, and fruits gathered from the furbolgs. The blessed meal briefly restores the afflicted creatures’ sanity and reveals the satyr overseer responsible.
